# AICL Example: Blockchain Core Protocol
# Comprehensive blockchain core implementing PoW/PoS hybrid consensus, block validation,
# chain integrity verification, mempool management, and peer-to-peer network discovery

Goal Build a production-grade blockchain core protocol supporting hybrid PoW/PoS consensus, immutable chain storage, efficient transaction mempool, and resilient peer-to-peer networking

Constraint Maximum block size shall not exceed 2MB to prevent network congestion and ensure propagation latency under 500ms across global nodes
Constraint All consensus transitions must maintain chain finality guarantees with at least 2/3 validator agreement
Constraint Transaction throughput must sustain at minimum 10,000 TPS under normal network conditions
Constraint Block production interval target of 6 seconds with +/-1 second tolerance
Constraint Peer discovery must complete within 30 seconds for new nodes joining the network

Risk Chain reorganization exceeding 6 blocks causes transaction rollback and double-spend vulnerability
Recovery Trigger emergency finalization protocol, halt block production, broadcast checkpoint to all peers, and require supermajority validator confirmation before resuming
Risk Eclipse attack isolates node from honest network peers
Recovery Implement outbound connection diversity enforcement, random peer selection with anchor nodes, and latency-based anomaly detection to reconnect to verified peers
Risk Mempool saturation leads to transaction eviction and increased gas price volatility
Recovery Activate mempool prioritization by fee-per-weight-unit, implement aging eviction with minimum broadcast window, and signal fee market adjustment to wallets
Risk Consensus fork due to validator set disagreement on PoW/PoS transition boundary
Recovery Lock consensus parameters at transition height, require 95% stake-weighted vote to override, and replay blocks from last agreed checkpoint
Risk 51% hash rate concentration threatens PoW chain integrity
Recovery Auto-escalate PoS finality overlay, increase confirmation depth requirement to 12 blocks, and broadcast mining decentralization alert

Layer BlockchainCore
    SubLayer: ConsensusEngine
        # Hybrid PoW/PoS consensus mechanism
    SubLayer: BlockManagement
        # Block construction, validation, and storage
    SubLayer: MempoolService
        # Transaction pool management and fee estimation
    SubLayer: PeerNetwork
        # P2P discovery, gossip protocol, and connection management
    SubLayer: ChainState
        # Immutable ledger state and UTXO/account model tracking

Validation Block hash must satisfy current difficulty target with leading zeros matching epoch difficulty
Validation Merkle root of transactions must match block header merkle_root field exactly
Validation Block timestamp must be within 15 minutes of median peer time to prevent timestamp manipulation
Validation Each transaction signature must verify against declared public key using secp256k1 ECDSA
Validation Cumulative chain work must strictly increase with each appended block
Validation Validator stake proof must exceed minimum delegation threshold of 1000 tokens
Validation Block gas limit must not exceed maximum network parameter of 30 million gas units
Validation Peer connection count must remain between minimum 8 and maximum 125 active connections

Optimize: Block propagation latency across global network

    use sha2::{Sha256, Digest};
    use secp256k1::{Secp256k1, Message, PublicKey, Signature};

    fn mine_block(header: &BlockHeader, difficulty: u32) -> Option<(u64, String)> {
        let target = "0".repeat(difficulty as usize);
        let mut nonce = 0u64;
        while nonce < u64::MAX {
            let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
            hasher.update(header.previous_hash.as_bytes());
            hasher.update(header.merkle_root.as_bytes());
            hasher.update(&nonce.to_le_bytes());
            hasher.update(&header.timestamp.to_le_bytes());
            let hash = format!("{:x}", hasher.finalize());
            if hash.starts_with(&target) {
                return Some((nonce, hash));
            }
            nonce += 1;
        }
        None
    }

    fn validate_pow(block_hash: &str, difficulty: u32) -> bool {
        let target = "0".repeat(difficulty as usize);
        block_hash.starts_with(&target)
    }

    fn compute_merkle_root(tx_hashes: &[String]) -> String {
        if tx_hashes.is_empty() {
            return "0".repeat(64);
        }
        let mut layer: Vec<String> = tx_hashes.to_vec();
        while layer.len() > 1 {
            let mut next = Vec::new();
            for chunk in layer.chunks(2) {
                let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
                hasher.update(chunk[0].as_bytes());
                let partner = chunk.get(1).unwrap_or(&chunk[0]);
                hasher.update(partner.as_bytes());
                next.push(format!("{:x}", hasher.finalize()));
            }
            layer = next;
        }
        layer[0].clone()
    }

    fn verify_signature(pubkey: &PublicKey, msg: &[u8], sig: &Signature) -> bool {
        let secp = Secp256k1::verification_only();
        let message = Message::from_slice(msg).unwrap();
        secp.verify(&message, sig, pubkey).is_ok()
    }
    }

# Multi-chain cryptocurrency wallet supporting HD key derivation, transaction signing,
# UTXO management, DeFi protocol integration, and cross-chain asset bridging

Goal Build a secure multi-chain cryptocurrency wallet with hierarchical deterministic key generation, comprehensive UTXO and account model support, seamless DeFi protocol interaction, and hardware wallet integration

Constraint Private keys must never leave secure enclave or HSM boundary under any circumstances including debugging or crash dumps
Constraint All transaction signing operations must complete within 2 seconds on supported hardware targets
Constraint Wallet must support at minimum 20 blockchain networks with unified address derivation
Constraint Seed phrase backup must use BIP-39 with 256-bit entropy and passphrase support
Constraint Transaction broadcast must implement replay protection across all supported chains

Risk Private key exposure through memory dump or side-channel attack
Recovery Immediately rotate compromised keys via HD derivation path advancement, sweep funds to new addresses, disable compromised key branch, and generate incident report with forensic timeline
Risk Seed phrase loss prevents wallet recovery and permanent fund inaccessibility
Recovery Enforce multi-location seed backup verification, implement social recovery with guardian threshold, and maintain encrypted cloud backup with hardware key decryption
Risk Transaction fee estimation error causes overpayment or stuck transactions

Risk DeFi smart contract exploit drains approved token allowances

    from hashlib import sha256, sha512
    import hmac
    from bip32 import BIP32
    from bip39 import Mnemonic

    def derive_hd_key(seed_bytes: bytes, path: str, network: str) -> dict:
        bip32 = BIP32.from_seed(seed_bytes)
        keypair = bip32.get_key_from_path(path)
        pubkey = keypair.key.public_key
        address = pubkey.address(network)
        return {
            "derivation_path": path,
            "public_key": pubkey.hex(),
            "address": address,
            "chain_code": bip32.chain_code.hex(),
            "depth": path.count("/") - 1
        }

    def generate_mnemonic(strength: int = 256) -> str:
        mnemonic = Mnemonic("english")
        return mnemonic.generate(strength=strength)

    def validate_mnemonic(phrase: str) -> bool:
        mnemonic = Mnemonic("english")
        return mnemonic.check(phrase)

    def coin_select_utxos(utxos: list, target: float, fee_rate: float) -> list:
        selected = []
        total = 0.0
        base_fee = 10.0  # virtual bytes base
        for utxo in sorted(utxos, key=lambda u: u["amount"]):
            if total >= target + base_fee * fee_rate:
                break
            selected.append(utxo)
            total += utxo["amount"]
            base_fee += 68.0  # approximate P2WPKH input size
        if total < target + base_fee * fee_rate:
            return []
        return selected

    def compute_sighash(tx_data: bytes) -> bytes:
        return sha256(sha256(tx_data).digest()).digest()
    }

# Comprehensive decentralized finance platform implementing automated market making,
# liquidity pools, yield farming, lending/borrowing protocols, flash loans, and DAO governance

Goal Build a full-stack DeFi platform with AMM-based token swapping, multi-tier liquidity pools, incentivized yield farming, over-collateralized lending, atomic flash loans, and on-chain governance with token-weighted voting

Constraint All lending positions must maintain health factor above 1.0 at all times with automatic liquidation at threshold 1.05
Constraint Flash loans must execute and repay within a single atomic transaction block
Constraint AMM pools must maintain constant product invariant k = x * y with maximum 0.3 percent swap fee
Constraint Governance proposals require minimum 1 percent of total supply quorum and 50 percent supermajority to pass
Constraint Maximum leverage ratio for borrowing must not exceed 5x collateral value

Risk Impermanent loss exceeds yield earnings for liquidity providers during volatile market conditions
Recovery Auto-trigger LP withdrawal warning when impermanent loss exceeds 10 percent of position value, provide hedging strategy recommendations, and adjust pool fee tiers dynamically
Risk Oracle price manipulation causes incorrect liquidation of healthy lending positions
Recovery Implement TWAP oracle with 30-minute averaging window, require price deviation check against multiple oracle sources, and reverse liquidations with compensatory insurance fund payout
Risk Flash loan attack exploits AMM price oracle to drain liquidity pool reserves
Recovery Enforce delayed price updates for oracle reads, implement circuit breaker on swap volume exceeding 10 percent of pool reserves per block, and require multi-block confirmation for large swaps
Risk Governance attack through flash loan acquired voting power
Recovery Implement vote-escrow token model with minimum 7-day lock before voting eligibility, snapshot voting at proposal creation block, and flash loan detection on governance token transfers
Risk Smart contract vulnerability enables unauthorized fund extraction from lending pools
Recovery Activate emergency pause via multi-sig guardian, isolate affected pool contracts, deploy patched implementation through proxy upgrade, and distribute insurance fund coverage to affected users

Layer DeFiPlatform
    SubLayer: AMMEngine

    // SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
    pragma solidity ^0.8.19;

    contract DeFiAMM {
        uint256 public constant FEE_DENOMINATOR = 10000;
        uint256 public feeRate = 30; // 0.3%
        mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public reserves;

        function swap(
            address tokenIn,
            address tokenOut,
            uint256 amountIn,
            uint256 minAmountOut
        ) external returns (uint256 amountOut) {
            uint256 reserveIn = reserves[tokenIn][tokenOut];
            uint256 reserveOut = reserves[tokenOut][tokenIn];
            require(reserveIn > 0 && reserveOut > 0, "Pool empty");

            uint256 fee = (amountIn * feeRate) / FEE_DENOMINATOR;
            uint256 amountInWithFee = amountIn - fee;

            amountOut = (amountInWithFee * reserveOut) / (reserveIn + amountInWithFee);
            require(amountOut >= minAmountOut, "Slippage exceeded");

            reserves[tokenIn][tokenOut] += amountIn;
            reserves[tokenOut][tokenIn] -= amountOut;
        }

        function getAmountOut(
            uint256 amountIn,
            uint256 reserveIn,
            uint256 reserveOut
        ) public pure returns (uint256) {
            uint256 amountInWithFee = amountIn * 997;
            return (amountInWithFee * reserveOut) / (reserveIn * 1000 + amountInWithFee);
        }
    }

    contract LendingPool {
        struct Position {
            uint256 collateral;
            uint256 borrowed;
            uint256 lastAccrualBlock;
        }

        uint256 public constant LIQUIDATION_THRESHOLD = 105; // 1.05 health factor
        uint256 public constant CLOSE_FACTOR = 50; // 50% max repayment
        uint256 public constant LIQUIDATION_BONUS = 108; // 8% bonus

        mapping(address => Position) public positions;

        function healthFactor(address user, uint256 collateralPrice, uint256 borrowPrice)
            public view returns (uint256) {
            Position memory pos = positions[user];
            uint256 collateralValue = (pos.collateral * collateralPrice * LIQUIDATION_THRESHOLD) / 100;
            uint256 borrowValue = pos.borrowed * borrowPrice;
            return collateralValue / borrowValue;
        }
    }
    }

        }

        mapping(address => uint256) public balances;
        uint256 public marketplaceFeeBps = 250; // 2.5%

            require(ownerOf(tokenId) == msg.sender, "Not owner");

            Listing memory listing = listings[tokenId];
            require(listing.active, "Not listed");
            require(msg.value >= listing.price, "Insufficient payment");

            uint256 royaltyAmount = (listing.price * royaltyInfo(tokenId, listing.price).royaltyAmount) / listing.price;
            uint256 marketplaceFee = (listing.price * marketplaceFeeBps) / 10000;
            uint256 sellerProceeds = listing.price - royaltyAmount - marketplaceFee;

            payable(royaltyInfo(tokenId, listing.price).receiver).transfer(royaltyAmount);
            payable(listing.seller).transfer(sellerProceeds);
            listings[tokenId].active = false;
        }

        function royaltyInfo(uint256 tokenId, uint256 salePrice)
            public view override returns (address receiver, uint256 royaltyAmount) {
            // Implementation would look up collection royalty config
            receiver = creatorOf(tokenId);
            royaltyAmount = (salePrice * 500) / 10000; // 5% royalty
        }

# Comprehensive smart contract execution engine supporting compilation, gas optimization,
# virtual machine execution, state management, and formal verification

Goal Build a production-grade smart contract engine with multi-language compilation, aggressive gas optimization, deterministic VM execution with isolation guarantees, efficient Merkle-based state management, and formal verification integration for contract safety proofs

Constraint Gas metering must precisely account for every opcode execution with zero tolerance for undercharging
Constraint Contract execution must be deterministic across all nodes regardless of hardware or platform
Constraint State transitions must be atomic with complete rollback on execution failure
Constraint Memory allocation per contract must not exceed 32MB per execution context
Constraint Call stack depth must not exceed 1024 frames to prevent stack overflow attacks

Risk Reentrancy attack drains contract funds through recursive external calls
Recovery Implement reentrancy guard on all state-mutating functions, deploy reentrancy detection in VM with automatic execution halt, and audit all external call patterns
Risk Integer overflow in contract arithmetic produces incorrect state
Recovery Enforce checked arithmetic by default in VM execution, deploy overflow detection hooks, and require explicit unchecked blocks with developer acknowledgment
Risk Gas estimation inaccuracy causes transaction failure or overpayment
Recovery Implement multi-simulation gas estimation with safety margin, detect gas griefing patterns, and provide worst-case gas bound analysis during compilation
Risk Contract storage collision in proxy patterns corrupts state
Recovery Enforce EIP-1967 storage slots for proxy patterns, implement storage layout validation during upgrade, and detect collision during compilation
Risk Infinite loop in contract execution stalls block processing
Recovery Enforce strict gas limit per transaction, implement instruction-level timeout, and deploy static analysis detection for unbounded loops during compilation

    SubLayer: GasOptimizer
        # Opcode optimization, dead code elimination, constant folding
    SubLayer: VirtualMachine
        # Stack machine execution, memory model, gas metering
    SubLayer: StateManager
        # Merkle Patricia trie, account state, contract storage
    SubLayer: FormalVerifier

Validation Gas cost of compiled contract must not exceed estimated gas by more than 10 percent
Validation State root hash must match recomputed root after every block execution

    use sha3::{Keccak256, Digest};
    use std::collections::HashMap;

    struct EVM {
        stack: Vec<u256>,
        memory: Vec<u8>,
        pc: usize,
        gas: u64,
        storage: HashMap<[u8; 32], [u8; 32]>,
    }

    impl EVM {
        fn execute(&mut self, bytecode: &[u8], calldata: &[u8]) -> ExecutionResult {
            while self.pc < bytecode.len() && self.gas > 0 {
                let opcode = bytecode[self.pc];
                match opcode {
                    0x00 => break, // STOP
                    0x01 => self.op_add()?,
                    0x02 => self.op_mul()?,
                    0x54 => self.op_sload()?,
                    0x55 => self.op_sstore()?,
                    0x56 => self.op_jump()?,
                    0x60 => self.op_push1(bytecode)?,
                    _ => return ExecutionResult::UnknownOpcode(opcode),
                }
                self.gas -= 1; // Simplified gas accounting
                self.pc += 1;
            }
            ExecutionResult::Success(self.stack.pop().unwrap_or(0))
        }

        fn op_sload(&mut self) -> Result<(), VMError> {
            let key = self.stack_pop()?;
            let value = self.storage.get(&key.to_bytes())
                .copied()
                .unwrap_or([0u8; 32]);
            self.stack.push(u256::from_bytes(value));
            Ok(())
        }

        fn op_sstore(&mut self) -> Result<(), VMError> {
            let key = self.stack_pop()?.to_bytes();
            let value = self.stack_pop()?.to_bytes();
            self.gas = self.gas.checked_sub(20000)
                .ok_or(VMError::OutOfGas)?;
            self.storage.insert(key, value);
            Ok(())
        }

        fn compute_state_root(&self) -> [u8; 32] {
            let mut hasher = Keccak256::new();
            for (key, value) in &self.storage {
                hasher.update(key);
                hasher.update(value);
            }
            hasher.finalize().into()
        }
    }
    }

    func IssueCertificate(

        pubKey interface{},
    ) ([]byte, error) {
        certBytes, err := x509.CreateCertificate(
            rand.Reader, template, caCert, pubKey, caKey,
        )
        if err != nil {
            return nil, err
        }
        return certBytes, nil
    }

    func ValidateChain(
        cert *x509.Certificate,
        intermediates *x509.CertPool,
        roots *x509.CertPool,
    ) ([]*x509.Certificate, error) {
        opts := x509.VerifyOptions{
            Intermediates: intermediates,
            Roots:         roots,
            CurrentTime:   time.Now(),
            KeyUsages:     []x509.ExtKeyUsage{x509.ExtKeyUsageServerAuth},
        }
        chains, err := cert.Verify(opts)
        if err != nil {
            return nil, err
        }
        return chains[0], nil
    }

    func CheckRevocation(cert *x509.Certificate, crl *pkix.CertificateList) bool {
        for _, revoked := range crl.TBSCertList.RevokedCertificates {
            if cert.SerialNumber.Cmp(revoked.SerialNumber) == 0 {
                return true
            }
        }
        return false
    }

    func ComputeFingerprint(certBytes []byte) string {
        h := sha256.Sum256(certBytes)
        return fmt.Sprintf("%x", h)
    }

    func GenerateSerialNumber() (*big.Int, error) {
        serialNumberLimit := new(big.Int).Lsh(big.NewInt(1), 128)
        return rand.Int(rand.Reader, serialNumberLimit)
    }

    use ark_ff::{Field, PrimeField};
    use ark_groth16::{Groth16, Proof, VerifyingKey};
    use ark_r1cs_std::prelude::*;
    use ark_relations::r1cs::{ConstraintSynthesizer, ConstraintSystemRef};
    use ark_bn254::Bn254;
    use ark_snark::SNARK;

    struct MerkleMembershipCircuit<F: PrimeField> {
        leaf: Option<F>,
        path_elements: Vec<Option<F>>,
        path_indices: Vec<Option<bool>>,
        root: Option<F>,
    }

    impl<F: PrimeField> ConstraintSynthesizer<F> for MerkleMembershipCircuit<F> {
        fn generate_constraints(self, cs: ConstraintSystemRef<F>) -> ark_relations::r1cs::Result<()> {
            let leaf = FpVar::new_input(cs.clone(), || self.leaf.ok_or(ark_relations::r1cs::SynthesisError::AssignmentMissing))?;
            let root = FpVar::new_input(cs.clone(), || self.root.ok_or(ark_relations::r1cs::SynthesisError::AssignmentMissing))?;

            let mut current = leaf;
            for (i, (element, index)) in self.path_elements.iter().zip(self.path_indices.iter()).enumerate() {
                let sibling = FpVar::new_witness(cs.clone(), || element.ok_or(ark_relations::r1cs::SynthesisError::AssignmentMissing))?;
                let is_right = Boolean::new_witness(cs.clone(), || index.ok_or(ark_relations::r1cs::SynthesisError::AssignmentMissing))?;

                let hash_input = conditionally_select(&is_right, &sibling, &current, &current, &sibling);
                current = poseidon_hash(&hash_input);
            }

            current.enforce_equal(&root)?;
            Ok(())
        }
    }

    fn generate_groth16_proof(
        circuit: MerkleMembershipCircuit<ark_bn254::Fr>,
        pk: &ark_groth16::ProvingKey<Bn254>,
    ) -> Proof<Bn254> {

        vk: &VerifyingKey<Bn254>,
        proof: &Proof<Bn254>,
        public_inputs: &[ark_bn254::Fr],
    ) -> bool {
        Groth16::verify(vk, public_inputs, proof).unwrap()
    }

    type KeyManager struct {

        auditLogger  AuditLogger
        keyStore     KeyStore
    }

    func (km *KeyManager) GenerateKey(algorithm string, keySize int, classification string) (*CryptoKey, error) {
        keyBytes, err := km.hsmClient.GenerateRandom(keySize / 8)
        if err != nil {
            return nil, err
        }

        fingerprint := sha256.Sum256(keyBytes)
        key := &CryptoKey{
            KeyID:         generateUUID(),
            Algorithm:     algorithm,
            KeySize:       keySize,
            Classification: classification,
            Fingerprint:   hex.EncodeToString(fingerprint[:]),
            Status:        "active",
            CreationDate:  time.Now(),
        }

        km.auditLogger.Log(AuditEntry{
            Operation:  "GENERATE_KEY",
            KeyID:      key.KeyID,
            Result:     "success",
            Timestamp:  time.Now(),
        })

        return key, nil
    }

    func (km *KeyManager) RotateKey(currentKeyID string) (*CryptoKey, error) {
        current, err := km.keyStore.Get(currentKeyID)
        if err != nil {
            return nil, err
        }

        newKey, err := km.GenerateKey(current.Algorithm, current.KeySize, current.Classification)
        if err != nil {
            return nil, err
        }

        current.Status = "deprecated"
        km.keyStore.Update(current)

        return newKey, nil
    }

    func computeHKDF(ikm, salt, info []byte, length int) []byte {
        extractor := hmac.New(sha256.New, salt)
        extractor.Write(ikm)
        prk := extractor.Sum(nil)

        var okm []byte
        var prev []byte
        for len(okm) < length {
            expander := hmac.New(sha256.New, prk)
            expander.Write(prev)
            expander.Write(info)
            expander.Write([]byte{byte(len(okm)/32 + 1)})
            prev = expander.Sum(nil)
            okm = append(okm, prev...)
        }
        return okm[:length]
    }
    }

    use x25519_dalek::{EphemeralSecret, PublicKey, SharedSecret};

    fn x3dh_key_agreement(
        my_identity: &PrivateKey,
        my_ephemeral: &EphemeralSecret,
        their_identity: &PublicKey,
        their_signed_prekey: &PublicKey,
        their_one_time_prekey: Option<&PublicKey>,
    ) -> ([u8; 32], [u8; 32]) {
        let dh1 = my_identity.diffie_hellman(their_identity);
        let dh2 = my_identity.diffie_hellman(their_signed_prekey);
        let dh3 = my_ephemeral.diffie_hellman(their_signed_prekey);

        let mut shared_secret = Vec::new();
        shared_secret.extend_from_bytes(dh1.as_bytes());
        shared_secret.extend_from_bytes(dh2.as_bytes());
        shared_secret.extend_from_bytes(dh3.as_bytes());

        if let Some(otpk) = their_one_time_prekey {
            let dh4 = my_ephemeral.diffie_hellman(otpk);
            shared_secret.extend_from_bytes(dh4.as_bytes());
        }

        let hkdf = Hkdf::<Sha256>::new(None, &shared_secret);
        let mut root_key = [0u8; 32];
        let mut chain_key = [0u8; 32];
        hkdf.expand(b"root", &mut root_key).unwrap();
        hkdf.expand(b"chain", &mut chain_key).unwrap();

        (root_key, chain_key)
    }

    fn ratchet_step(
        root_key: &[u8; 32],
        dh_output: &[u8; 32],
    ) -> ([u8; 32], [u8; 32]) {
        let hkdf = Hkdf::<Sha256>::new(Some(root_key), dh_output);
        let mut new_root = [0u8; 32];
        let mut new_chain = [0u8; 32];
        hkdf.expand(b"root", &mut new_root).unwrap();
        hkdf.expand(b"chain", &mut new_chain).unwrap();
        (new_root, new_chain)
    }

    fn encrypt_message(
        chain_key: &[u8; 32],
        plaintext: &[u8],
    ) -> (Vec<u8>, [u8; 32]) {
        let hkdf = Hkdf::<Sha256>::new(None, chain_key);
        let mut message_key = [0u8; 32];
        let mut next_chain = [0u8; 32];
        hkdf.expand(b"msg", &mut message_key).unwrap();
        hkdf.expand(b"next", &mut next_chain).unwrap();

        let cipher = Aes256Gcm::new_from_slice(&message_key).unwrap();
        let nonce = Nonce::from_slice(b"unique nonce"); // Simplified
        let ciphertext = cipher.encrypt(nonce, plaintext).unwrap();

        (ciphertext, next_chain)
    }

    fn compute_safety_number(identity_a: &[u8], identity_b: &[u8]) -> String {
        use sha2::Digest;
        let mut hasher = sha2::Sha512::new();
        let (first, second) = if identity_a < identity_b {
            (identity_a, identity_b)
        } else {
            (identity_b, identity_a)
        };
        hasher.update(first);
        hasher.update(second);
        let hash = hasher.finalize();
        format!("{:060}", u64::from_be_bytes(hash[..8].try_into().unwrap()) % 1000000000000000000)
    }

# AICL Example: Homomorphic Encryption Service
# Privacy-preserving computation service implementing FHE with CKKS and BFV schemes,
# encrypted analytics, secure multi-party computation, and confidential smart contracts

Goal Build a homomorphic encryption service providing fully homomorphic encryption with CKKS for approximate arithmetic and BFV for exact integer computation, enabling privacy-preserving analytics, encrypted machine learning inference, secure multi-party computation, and confidential smart contract execution

Constraint Encrypted computation must produce results decryptable to match plaintext computation within declared noise budget
Constraint CKKS scheme must maintain precision of at least 15 decimal digits for approximate computations
Constraint BFV scheme must produce exact integer results for arithmetic operations without overflow
Constraint Key generation must complete within 30 seconds for standard security parameters
Constraint Bootstrapping must refresh ciphertext noise within 120 seconds for standard parameter sets

Risk Noise growth during computation exceeds budget and produces incorrect decryption results
Recovery Monitor noise budget estimation after each operation, trigger automatic bootstrapping at 70 percent threshold, and reject operations that would exceed noise budget
Risk Side-channel attack during homomorphic evaluation reveals plaintext data
Recovery Implement constant-time polynomial evaluation, randomize ciphertext representation, and use data-oblivious branching for all conditional operations
Risk Parameter selection vulnerability reduces security level below 128-bit equivalent
Recovery Enforce minimum parameter validation against HomomorphicEncryption.org security standard, implement automated parameter selection with security proof, and reject custom parameters below threshold
Risk Ciphertext multiplication blowup causes memory exhaustion during complex evaluations
Recovery Implement tensor product decomposition for large ciphertexts, enforce memory budgets per computation, and apply modulus switching proactively to reduce ciphertext size
Risk Key switching vulnerability enables key recovery from evaluation keys
Recovery Use honest-but-curious key switching with random encryption, implement relinearization with verified evaluation keys, and audit key switching procedures for information leakage

        Encryptor encryptor_;

        Evaluator evaluator_;

    public:
        FHEService(size_t poly_modulus_degree, vector<int> coeff_modulus_bits) {
            EncryptionParameters params(scheme_type::ckks);
            params.set_poly_modulus_degree(poly_modulus_degree);
            params.set_coeff_modulus(CoeffModulus::Create(
                poly_modulus_degree, coeff_modulus_bits));

            context_ = make_shared<SEALContext>(params);
            keygen_ = KeyGenerator(*context_);
            keygen_.create_public_key(pk_);
            sk_ = keygen_.secret_key();
            keygen_.create_relin_keys(relin_keys_);
            keygen_.create_galois_keys(galois_keys_);

            encryptor_ = Encryptor(*context_, pk_);
            decryptor_ = Decryptor(*context_, sk_);
            evaluator_ = Evaluator(*context_);
        }

        Ciphertext encrypt_vector(const vector<double>& input, double scale) {
            Plaintext plain;
            ckks_encoder_.encode(input, scale, plain);
            Ciphertext cipher;
            encryptor_.encrypt(plain, cipher);
            return cipher;
        }

        vector<double> decrypt_vector(Ciphertext& cipher) {
            Plaintext plain;
            decryptor_.decrypt(cipher, plain);
            vector<double> result;
            ckks_encoder_.decode(plain, result);
            return result;
        }

        Ciphertext add_encrypted(Ciphertext& a, Ciphertext& b) {
            Ciphertext result;
            evaluator_.add(a, b, result);
            return result;
        }

        Ciphertext multiply_encrypted(Ciphertext& a, Ciphertext& b) {
            Ciphertext result;
            evaluator_.multiply(a, b, result);
            evaluator_.relinearize_inplace(result, relin_keys_);
            return result;
        }

        Ciphertext bootstrap(Ciphertext& cipher) {
            // Bootstrapping would use the built-in SEAL bootstrapping
            // or custom implementation for CKKS
            evaluator_.mod_switch_to_inplace(cipher, 
                context_->last_context_data()->parms_id());
            return cipher;
        }
